description: This file contains handlers for real-time memory event subscription via WebSocket and SSE, as well as fetching historical memory event data, within a control plane component of a monitoring system.

classes.name: MemoryEventsHandler
classes.description: Handler struct managing WebSocket and SSE connections for real-time memory events and subscribing to memory change notifications.

methods.name: NewMemoryEventsHandler
methods.description: Constructor for MemoryEventsHandler, initializes WebSocket upgrader.

methods.name: WebSocketHandler
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connections, forwards real-time memory events with optional pattern filtering.

methods.name: SSEHandler
methods.description: Handles Server-Sent Events connections, streams memory events with pattern filtering.

methods.name: GetEventHistoryHandler
methods.description: Returns a handler function to fetch historical memory events based on query filters.
